name: Author application code with an AI coding assistant
description: A developer uses an IDE-integrated assistant to draft or complete code in a supported institutional application.
accountable_role: Application Developer (supervised by Engineering Manager, Enterprise Applications)

name: Review a change that contains AI-generated code
description: A second engineer reviews a pull request whose author has indicated AI assistance was used.

name: Triage an incoming support ticket using AI summarization
description: Service desk staff use an AI summary of a long ticket thread to decide routing and priority.

name: Draft user-facing documentation with an AI assistant
description: Staff draft help articles or release notes with AI assistance before human edit and publication.

name: Assemble a data extract used as AI prompt or retrieval context
description: An engineer pulls records from an institutional system to supply as context to an AI feature.

name: Evaluate and onboard a new AI vendor tool
description: A unit requests a new AI-capable product; security, privacy, and contract review run before access is granted.
accountable_role: Procurement Liaison with Information Security review

name: Approve a release containing AI-assisted changes
description: A named approver signs off a deployment that includes changes authored with AI assistance.

name: Handle AI prompt and response logs that may contain institutional data
description: Application and vendor logs capture prompt text and model output; someone must classify, retain, and dispose of them.

name: Notice and respond to a vendor model or version change
description: A vendor silently changes the underlying model or version; someone must notice and decide whether to re-test dependent workflows.
accountable_role: Platform Engineering (practice observed; no role is named for this task in any policy reviewed)
